desc: Implement complete solution: subset/LCM precomputation via lowbit DP, per-number cost array `(L - x % L) % L`, and mask DP with per-number snapshot so each `nums` element is used at most once (iterate `sub` over submasks of `full ^ mask`); init `dp[0]=0`, return `dp[full]`.

Verify correctness against the three examples (expect 1, 2, 0) plus edge cases: already-satisfied target (0 ops), duplicate targets, one number covering multiple targets via LCM, single-element nums, and large LCM (e.g., coprime targets near 1e4).
Confirm complexity ~`O(n * 3^k)` with `k<=4` (≈4e6 relaxations) fits comfortably; micro-optimize inner loop only if needed (skip `old[mask]==inf`, local variable binding).
